text:
Ryan M: Quick postmortem follow-up — we need to lock owners and deadlines for the vendor dependency mitigations (cloud region auth fail + model-registry token lapse). I sketched an initial action list below, please claim or correct.

Katie L: I can take cloud provider SLA/contact verification. Will try to confirm RRT/SLA escalation path by EOD Wed. :ok_hand:

Omar A: I'll own model-registry mitigations (pinning, fallback variants, automated rollbacks). ETA end of week to propose rollout plan.

Sasha V: I'll handle auth-provider followups (refresh token monitoring, retry policy, and fallback auth provider). Need legal on contract clause for 3rd-party rate limits — who's the legal contact? @paula?

Paula G: Legal is looped — will intro to vendor-ops counsel tomorrow. Also suggest we add a recurring pattern worksheet to the postmortem to capture frequency + blast radius.

devops-bot: New tasks created: https://tracker.internal/tasks/INC-2792, INC-2793, INC-2794 — owners: Katie L (INC-2792), Omar A (INC-2793), Sasha V (INC-2794). Slack thread and postmortem linked in each task.

Ryan M: Good — let's set concrete deadlines. Katie: SLA/contact verification by 2026-04-01. Omar: rollout plan with fallback testing by 2026-04-03. Sasha: monitoring + retry policy PR by 2026-04-02. Paula: legal intro by 2026-03-31.

Katie L: Confirmed SLA/contacts by 2026-04-01. I'll also ask cloud rep for a runbook walk-through and request a page for our on-call.

Omar A: For model-registry: plan will include pinned model hashes, an automated canary with a 1% traffic route, and an expedited rollback script. Will add runbook steps to INC-2793.

Sasha V: Monitoring notes — add alert for token refresh error rate >0.5% over 5m, and a secondary alert if auth latency > 1s for 2m. I'll post the PR for alerting rules and a small library to centralize refresh retries.

Paula G: Legal intro sent to Sasha and Ryan. Also flagged possible SLA credit clause — might need a PO review if we push for stronger SLOs.

Ryan M: Two additional asks: 1) Can we automate a weekly quick-check that verifies model-registry auth tokens are refreshing (simple smoke) and 2) rotate ownership of these vendor follow-ups monthly for redundancy? Thoughts?

Katie L: Weekly smoke check: yes, I can add to monitoring. Monthly rotation: agree — propose primary + backup per ticket. I'll update INC-2792 with backup = "Infra on-call" and rotation cadence.

Omar A: For rollouts, backup owner makes sense. I'll add a runbook step for handoff and create a short checklist for new owners to sign off on before rotation.

Sasha V: Backup for auth: assign to "Security on-call" as backup. Will document handoff steps and include token revocation test.

Paula G: FYI — I'm noticing this pattern: auth token issues + model-registry spikes have happened 3 times in last 8 months (see postmortem index). We should schedule a quarterly dependency review to look for systemic vendors causing recurring incidents.

Ryan M: Agreed. I'll schedule a 45m quarterly review with product, infra, security, and legal. First review scheduled 2026-04-15 11:00 PDT. Invite incoming.

devops-bot: Reminder set and calendar invite created: Quarterly Vendor Dependency Review — 2026-04-15 11:00 PDT. Link: https://calendar.internal/e/dep-review-2026-04-15

Katie L: Quick note: I've also opened a support case with the cloud provider to ask for bus/error logs for the 03/24 incident. Case ID: CP-998221. I'll update INC-2792 when they reply.

Omar A: For transparency, I'll pin a small test harness in the model-registry repo to run the fallback behavior locally — link in INC-2793.

Sasha V: Putting a short checklist here so it's visible: 1) SLA contacts confirmed (Katie) 2) Model pin + canary (Omar) 3) Auth monitoring + retry policy (Sasha) 4) Legal intro (Paula) 5) Weekly smoke + rotation cadence (Katie) 6) Quarterly dependency review (Ryan). Please react :thumbsup: when you accept.

Ryan M: Accepting. I'll update the postmortem with this action table and close the follow-up loop after the first-week check-ins. Thanks everyone. :heart:

Paula G: One last ask — can we add a short note in the runbooks about expected vendor response windows for each critical path? Helps on-call decide when to escalate.

Katie L: Will add vendor response windows to INC-2792 runbook section.

Omar A: Added initial fallback script link to INC-2793 and a tiny test case. Will expand after the canary results.

Sasha V: PR opened for alerting + retry lib, linking INC-2794. Requesting review from infra and security.

devops-bot: Thread archived to incident folder and linked to PM doc: https://docs.internal/postmortems/INC-2790-followup

Ryan M: Closing thread — we'll check back during the weekly sync. If anything blocks owners before then, drop in #incidents or ping me directly.
